items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Marilyn Moore is mentioned by the Interviewer as his own connection to Al Haig; the Interviewee (Mose Allison) does not mention any personal interaction or relationship with Marilyn Moore.

ctx.x: Great Neck? Yeah. Joe Cohn was on the floor, crawling around. Marilyn Moore, I had met her in Galveston and played behind her. She was my connection with Al. Al took me on right away, and he started giving me gigs. He wasn’t working much at that time. He was writing mostly on Broadway musicals. I later worked with Al and Zoot at the Half Note, but...
That was one of the things you enjoyed more than anything else, I think, was working with them.
